content:
Alex Chen: Quick follow-up from last night's outage — combining cloud provider flakiness + model-registry auth failures. We promised a short action list and owners. Starting thread for commitments.
Maya Patel: thanks. I'll own the remediation docket. High level: 1) short-term auth fallback 2) model-registry token TTL rotation 3) provider-region routing rules. ETA for proposals? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Devon Rivera: I can take #1 (auth fallback). Plan: implement a health-probe + cached fallback token in edge proxy for 72h. Will open PR with a small shim and feature flag. Target: EOD tomorrow.
Leah Kim: For #2 (token rotation), we need a one-week runbook with rollbacks. I'll draft playbook and include KMS steps. Suggest a dry-run against staging on Thu. :calendar:
Samir Gupta: Noted recurring pattern: we saw auth TTL + model-registry burst -> cascade. Propose a regression monitor for token expiry spikes and a weekly synthetic that hits the registry under high QPS. I'll add to monitoring backlog and own implementation.
Alex Chen: OpsBot, can you paste the incident summary link and runbook pointers?
OpsBot: Incident report created: https://redwood.incidents/IR-2026-042 (summary + timeline). Runbook snapshot: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/model-registry-fallback. Incident severity: P1, duration ~32m, impacted requests ~0.8% of hosted traffic.
Maya Patel: OK owners: Devon -> auth fallback shim, Leah -> rotation playbook + dry-run, Samir -> monitoring + synthetic. Alex -> stakeholder comms + SLAs. I'll track in the remediation spreadsheet and ping weekly.
Devon Rivera: quick note on implementation: fallback will check primary token auth (200), then fallback cached token if primary 5xx/timeout. Pseudo: 
```
if auth_check() == 200:
  proceed()
else:
  use_cached_token()
```
Feature flag: ff.auth_fallback = on/off.
Leah Kim: Dry-run plan: staging namespace, 30m at 2x normal QPS, rotate one subset of keys. Rollback plan included. I'll post schedule by EOD today.
Samir Gupta: For monitoring, will create an alert: model_registry.auth_fail_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page oncall + trigger canary route. Add a weekly run at Tue 03:00 UTC to surface regressions pre-peak.
Alex Chen: Timelines recap: Devon EOD tomorrow for PR; Leah runbook + dry-run schedule by EOD today; Samir monitoring alert & weekly synthetic by next Tue; Maya to collate into spreadsheet and start weekly 15m standups starting next Mon. If anyone needs help, ping #eng-oncall.
Maya Patel: Recording action items in spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/1-remediation-docket. I'll include owners, acceptance criteria, and target dates. Please add links to PRs and runbook pages.
Leah Kim: Also recommend a one-off cross-team drill after we close these items — simulate provider auth flake and failover to alternate region/model variant. 1-2hr drill. Suggest slot next sprint.
Devon Rivera: +1 for drill. I'll wire the fallback into canary flow so drill is realistic.
Samir Gupta: FYI I'll tag this under recurring-incident-patterns for quarterly review.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Closing thread for realtime updates — please post final PR links and mark items DONE in the sheet. :thumbsup:
